content: “*Awagaaka ni waamwifu, mbasawa mbwe musarigire mbalage ekintu ekia ndi.”
Olwa waawurra na awagamba-gambra mu Oluibrania, waasarigira kiri. Kutio Paulo yagia emberi na awoola otino,

“Inze ndi *Omuyaudi. Nyaiwulwa Taaso mu ekialo ekia Siliisia, ni nyakomera Yerusaleemu ano mu amakono aga *Gamalieli na angerera mu endagirra ezia waaguukwa wiifu. Nyakola emirimo egia Katonda na amaani gange goona kiomo muwona reero mukola mutino.
Nyanyaasia awantu awaawanga ni walonda engira eya *Kristo eno, kandi nyagera wafwa. Nya-ambanga awasaaza alala na awakazi ni mbaira mu owusiwe.

Kuwuene Omukangasi owa *awoozia alala na awakengi awa ekiina waesa wawalaga, aeniki niwo awampanga ebaruwa okuirra awiina waawu awari Damaskaasi. Kutio nyagianga eyo ni nyamba awantu wano ni mbasiwa ne eminyororo kandi ni mbareeta Yerusaleemu okuswawukwa.
“Owuire wulala ni nyawanga ni ndi ampi okutuuka ku omugizi ogwa Damaskaasi, mu enyinga eya mukaaga omuwasu, nyaizukra idangaala erieru zerre ni riemera ku igulu ni rimmurika.
Nyagwa ansi amafunikira, nikuemao nyawurra omwoyo ni gunyeta kandi ni gundaga otino, ‘Saulo! Saulo! Ekigera no ondambiizie wululu otio niki?’
Nyamuwuuzia ntino, ‘Ni iwue anu owa ndambiizie?’ Yanyirania otino, ‘Ni inze Yesu Omunazareeti owa odambiizie wululu.’
Awantu awanyawanga nawo waawona owueru owuo ni ngawakawurra ekia omwoyo ogwo gwawoola.
“Nyamuwuuzia ntino, ‘Omwami ekia nsugaane nkole niki?’ Omwami yanyirania otino, ‘Ema ogie Damaskaasi aa ogia okulagwa ewintu wiona ewia omiire okuteerwao okuuza okukola.’
Awantu awa nyawanga nawo, waa-mpamba okukono waanyira Damaskaasi, aeniki owueru owuaema ku igulu owuo wuantangaazia amiiso wundeka omuwuunu.
“Yawangao omuntu oetwa mbwe Ananiasi. Yawanga omuntu oeere Katonda owuti ino kandi oambre endagirra ziifu. Kutio Awayaudi awamenyere Damaskaasi woona waamugamba-gambangako geeza.
Yaaza aimerra ampi ni inze nikuemao andaga otino, ‘Wamwifu Saulo, wona kandi!’ Amiiso gange gaiguka kalala kandi muwona.
“Nikuemao yandaga otino, ‘Katonda owa waasoifu waasawanga amiire okukulowola kugere omanye okuagala kwae kandi owone Omulowole waae Omweru otuukre kandi owurre amangʼana gaae na amatwi gaao.
Ooza okuwa no olaga awantu amangʼana goona aga owuine na aga owuriire ku iye.
Kutio kiwulao ekintu kindi kandi ekia okiarindirra, ni ema obatiiswe kugere oeruyiwue ku amawi gaao goona no oeta eriina eria *Omwami Yesu.’
“Lunyima ni miire okuirana Yerusaleemu ni nyasawanga mu *ekaalu, nyawona owusasuko.
Mu owusasuko owuo, nyawona Omwami na andaga otino, ‘Fuma Yerusaleemu wuangu-wuangu aeniki awantu wano ngawaaza okuganya ku ewintu ewia ooza okuwoola mbwe owuine kandi omanyire ku inze.’
“Inze nyamuirania ntino, ‘Omwami, awantu wano woona wamanyire geeza mbwe inze nio omuntu owagianga mu amasinagoogi ni nyamba kandi ni nkuba awantu awaganyire ku amangʼana gaao.
Lwona olwa Stefaano, owemirimo waao yaitwanga, nyawangao kandi nyaganya no okuitwa kwae, aa ni inze owa enguwo ezia awaamuita ziateewua mu amagulu gange.’
Omwami yandaga otino, ‘Iwue fuma ogie, aeniki nyiza okuira aliire mu ewialo ewia awantu awatari Awayaudi.’ ”

Awantu waawanga ni wamutegerezia ni wasarigiire kiri. No olwa yawoola amangʼana aga okugia ku awantu awatari Awayaudi, waatanika okukuba erioga wukalu ino ni wawoola watino, “Mumuite! Mumuite! Afwe aemeo! Ngʼasugaane okuwa omulamu!”
Waagia emberi ni wakuba erioga lwona ni watandula enguwo ziawu ni wazirigiza kungulu kandi ni wagunduusia egunduusi yoona.
Olwa omukangasi owa awa-iiye yawona otio, yalaga awa-iiye waae mbwe watoole Paulo waire mu ekambi aa wamenyere kandi wamuswawuke enkowa kugere awalage ekigera na awantu wamukubra erioga otio.

No olwa waawanga ni wamiire okumusiwa geeza kugere amuswawuke, Paulo yawuuzia omukangasi owa awa-iiye wundi owawanga na aimeriire ampi nae otino, “Endagirra iifu ngewoola mbwe kuwiiwi okuswawuka Omuruumi no owuoni wuae wukiari okutuukrwa?”
Olwa omukangasi owa awa-iiye oyo yawurra otio, yagia ku omukangasi omunene owa awa-iiye amuwuuzia otino “Oagala okukolaki kino? Omuntu oria no Omuruumi.”
Kutio omukangasi omunene owa awa-iiye yagia ku Paulo amuwuuzia otino, “Mbwe ori Omuruumi?” Paulo yamuirania otino, “Ee nintio.”
Omukangasi omunene oyo yamulaga otino, “Inze nyaoloola amasendi amangi kugere mbe Omuruumi. Ni iwue?” Paulo yamulaga mbwe, “Inze ndi Omuruumi ku okuiwulwa.”

Awa-iiye awaagianga okuwuuzia Paulo amangʼana waafuma waema ao. Olwa omukangasi omunene owa awa-iiye yatuukra mbwe Paulo yawanga Omuruumi, owuti wuamuamba ino aeniki yawanga na asiwre Omuruumi omwina waae.
Paulo airrwe ku oluwuga olwa awakengi awa ekiina

Enkio walwo omukangasi omunene owa awa-iiye yasiwula Paulo mala alagirra Omukangasi owa awoozia alala na awagaaka awa ekiina waikumie kugere areete Paulo emberi waawu aeniki yagalanga okumanya ekiagera ni waaingirra Paulo. Ni waamala okuikumia, yareeta Paulo emberi waawu.
